generate_text: generate text from an autoregressive transformer model using top-k or top-p filtering with optional eos token stopping
beam_search_decode: run beam search decoding on an autoregressive transformer with configurable beam width and stochastic sampling
train_autoregressive_model: train an autoregressive transformer with cross-entropy loss, optional MLM masking, z-loss, and looped exit gate training
filter_logits_top_k: filter transformer logits by keeping only the top-k highest-scoring tokens and setting others to negative infinity
contrastive_decode: apply contrastive decoding by combining expert and amateur model logits to improve generation quality
